name: Christ Crucified
overview: The crucifixion of Christ, as recorded in Mark 15:25 and Luke 23:33, reveals the solemn moment when Jesus was put to death at Calvary, the place of the skull, alongside criminals. Despite coming to His own, Jesus was rejected by many (John 1:11), yet belief in Him grants everlasting life, while unbelief results in remaining under God's wrath (John 3:36). Jesus affirms that He is the exclusive way to the Father (John 14:6) and that His kingdom is not of this world (John 18:36), underscoring the spiritual nature of His mission and the salvation secured through His sacrifice on the cross.
